links.comparator_used: Original CLOT model applied as-is to the CHD cohort, without refitting
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUROC) for HA-VTE in children with CHD
links.effect: AUROC original 0.80 (95% CI 0.75-0.85) vs refit on CHD cohort only 0.85 (0.81-0.89); updated model with added cardiac covariates 0.86 (0.81-0.90)
links.quote: The AUROC for the original (0.80 95% CI [0.75-0.85]), refit (0.85 [0.81-0.89]), and updated (0.86 [0.81-0.90]) models demonstrated excellent discriminatory ability within the CHD cohort.

design_hint: local refitting/recalibration of risk model to subpopulation
